name: 00-초기화
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); localStorage.removeItem('apt-my-products'); localStorage.removeItem('apt-interior-combos'); location.reload(); return 'reload' })()

name: 01-빈목록
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); document.querySelector('[data-tab=product]').click(); return { 제품수: v.products.length, ...est(), 목록: $('product-list').textContent } })()

name: 02-입력검사
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); const r = {}; fill('', 2000, 900, 800, '소파', 1000, ''); r.이름없음 = $('p-msg').textContent; fill('소파', 0, 900, 800, '소파', 1000, ''); r.크기0 = $('p-msg').textContent; fill('소파', 2000, 900, 800, '소파', 1000, 'javascript:alert(1)'); r.나쁜링크 = $('p-msg').textContent; r.제품수 = v.products.length; return r })()

name: 03-소파넣기
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); v.loadProposal('A'); document.getElementById('view-top').click(); v.controls.update(); fill('한샘 3인 소파 테스트', 2200, 950, 800, '소파', 1890000, 'https://example.com/sofa'); const p = v.products[0]; const s = v.state.furniture[p.id]; return { 제품수: v.products.length, 보임: s.visible, 자리: s.at, 모양: p.item.kind, 선택정보: $('info').innerText, 이름태그안됨: !$('info').querySelector('b'), 링크: $('info').querySelector('a')?.href, ...est(), 가구목록에있음: $('furniture-list').textContent.includes('내 제품') } })()

name: 04-두번째·견적
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); const r = {}; fill('수납장', 800, 400, 700, '수납장', 250000, ''); r.둘다놓음 = est(); const cb = $('product-list').querySelectorAll('input[type=checkbox]')[1]; cb.click(); r.하나뺌 = est(); key('z'); r.되돌림 = est(); key('z'); r.두번되돌림_수납장넣기전 = est(); key('y'); r.다시하기 = est(); return r })()

name: 05-조합저장·불러오기
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); const r = {}; $('combo-name').value = '제품테스트'; $('combo-save').click(); r.저장 = est(); v.loadProposal('B'); r.B안 = est(); [...document.querySelectorAll('#combo-list li')].find(li => li.textContent.includes('제품테스트')).querySelector('button').click(); r.불러옴 = est(); return r })()

name: 06-겹침검사
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); const p = v.products[0]; v.state.furniture[p.id].at = [...v.state.furniture.sofa.at]; v.selectFurniture(v.furnitureObjs.get(p.id)); v.state.furniture[p.id].rot = 0; return { 겹침: v.hitsFurniture(p.id), 정보: $('info').innerText } })()

name: 08-새로고침후
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); document.querySelector('[data-tab=product]').click(); const r = { 제품수: v.products.length, 이름: v.products.map(p => p.name), ...est() }; [...document.querySelectorAll('#combo-list li')].find(li => li.textContent.includes('제품테스트')).querySelector('button').click(); r.조합불러옴 = est(); return r })()

name: 09-화면
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); const p = v.products[0]; v.state.furniture[p.id].at = [4.7, 5.6]; v.state.furniture[p.id].rot = 0; v.selectFurniture(v.furnitureObjs.get(p.id)); document.getElementById('view-oblique').click(); v.controls.update(); return est() })()

name: 10-삭제
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const key = (k, o = {}) => window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: k, ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true, ...o })); const fill = (name, w, d, h, shape, price, url) => { $('p-name').value = name; $('p-w').value = w; $('p-d').value = d; $('p-h').value = h; $('p-shape').selectedIndex = [...$('p-shape').options].findIndex(o => o.text.startsWith(shape)); $('p-price').value = price; $('p-url').value = url; $('p-add').click() }; const est = () => ({ 놓인: $('est-count').textContent, 합계: $('est-placed').textContent, 전체: $('est-all').textContent }); const ids = () => v.products.map(p => p.id); window.confirm = () => true; const before = ids(); $('product-list').querySelector('button').click(); return { 전: before.length, 후: v.products.length, 장면에서빠짐: !v.furnitureObjs.has(before[0]), 저장: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('apt-my-products')).length, ...est() } })()
